messages:
maya: Legal asked for a single-page runbook + short FAQ for AWS KMS when onboarding Redwood Private (BYOK in customer account). Can we bullet the must-haves?

anil: Must-haves: CMK in customer account (BYOK), strict key policy permitting only customer admins + explicit redwood control-plane role, use encryption-context to bind DEKs to tenant/cluster, private endpoint restrictions (ViaService / SourceVpc), CloudTrail forwarding.

rachel: Add operational bits: short-lived grants to workers (2-8h), DEK TTL (default 24h), rewrap procedure for CMK rotation, and a check that agent canonicalizes encryption-context (string keys/values).

manual: infra-bot: NOTE: Policy analyzer suggests adding `kms:DescribeKey` for the monitoring principal.

maya: Runbook steps for incident (compromise suspected)?

anil: Runbook (short): 1) Remove/redact redwood role from CMK key policy. 2) List + retire outstanding grants (`aws kms list-grants` -> `retire-grant`/`revoke-grant`). 3) Rotate or create new CMK and rewrap ciphertext_DEKs (scripted Decrypt->GenerateDataKey->Encrypt). 4) Push DEK TTL bump and roll workers. 5) Audit CloudTrail for Decrypt/GenerateDataKey events and escalate.

rachel: CLI snippets to include in docs: `aws kms create-grant --key-id alias/customer-cmk --grantee-principal <role-arn> --operations Decrypt GenerateDataKey --constraints EncryptionContextSubset={"redwood:cluster":"<id>"}` and `aws kms list-grants --key-id alias/customer-cmk`.

anil: Ops notes: For PrivateLink endpoints verify exact kms:ViaService string (region-specific). Use aws:SourceVpc when available. Avoid broad wildcard principals in key policy.

maya: Audit retention ask: customers want multi-year. We should document CloudTrail -> S3 -> Glacier lifecycle and how to surface Decrypt alerts.

infra-bot: REMINDER: Ensure agent zeroes plaintext DEKs quickly and mlock sensitive pages when possible.

rachel: I'll assemble the one-pager and attach the key-policy snippet, grant lifecycle commands, small rewrap script, and incident checklist. Maya will send to legal.

maya: Perfect, thanks team.
